sense.text:
Psalms 18 is about the prophet, the forefather David, and through David Christ comes, to sit on his throne. “In my distress I called upon the Lord”: put yourself in this Bible. For those who have read the Bible, think: did this happen during the time of David or not?

“And cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.” There is going to come a time when we cry to the Lord and he is going to hear. That means something is going to happen here in the United States of America, something so bad, something we wouldn’t even imagine, that we’re going to have to really call upon the Lord for it.
After the Lord heard this cry, “Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.” Because God was mad.

“He bowed the heavens also, and came down”. This did not happen during the time of King David. Say it again: this did not happen. You will not read any text of the Lord coming down during the time of King David.
“And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly”: he rode upon angels. Those are the so-called UFOs. “Yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.”
“He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.” This is so heavy you can’t even describe it. Try to imagine such a thing.

“Hail stones and coals of fire”. When did David call upon the Lord, and hailstones and fire came, and God came down? It did not happen in the scriptures. It is letting you know it ain’t talking about back then. This is talking about this time, this day, this age.
“He sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them”: them is the nations.

This is so bad, so powerful, so omnipotent. “Then the channels of waters were seen”: the waters move all the way, so you can see the bottom of the sea. “And the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O Lord”. When the Lord comes down you’re going to see oceans part; you’re going to be able to see down to the deepest sea.
“He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.” Write these precepts down.

precepts.why:
“Thou didst march through the land in indignation”: the Lord is going to march through the land with indignation. “Thou didst thresh the heathen in anger”: he is going to thresh and destroy the nations.

“Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people”. He went forth for who? He’s not coming to save. Can somebody tell a Christian that? Can somebody call T.D. Jakes and say, listen, the Lord’s only coming back for the salvation of his people? He ain’t coming back to save all people on the planet earth.

“Thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck.” The head is America. When it discovers the foundation unto the neck, he’s going to cut the head off. That’s what he’s saying.

Jump over to the troops in Habakkuk. “They came out as a whirlwind to scatter me”: the nations are going to come against the Lord, the King of kings, to scatter him. “Their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly”: their rejoicing was to kill the Israelites secretly.

“When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice”, “that I might rest in the day of trouble”. Habakkuk said, I want to be dead; I don’t want to be alive when this happens. When the Lord returns I want to be at rest, that means asleep.

“When he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.” That’s why the white man puts out all these damnable movies about space aliens with three heads, with Will Smith punching aliens in the face, and we got to unite against the aliens. They are making a mockery of the scriptures. They’re so confident that when Christ returns with the angels they’re going to win. What do y’all think Space Force is about? Trump created this Space Force to fight the Lord, because they know this is the time, this is the day, this is the age.

We’re in that time period now, so you ain’t got no time to be falling off, following these idiots out there. A group of Israelites arguing about having sex with concubines in the kingdom: the prophets weren’t on the street arguing about sexing other nations. These cannot be the people. Who sits down having classes for hours upon hours about multiple wives? The prophets did not do that.

“And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven”: this is what we’re reading about in Psalms 18. “And then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.”

“And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” He sent from above and took me: that is the angels gathering the elect.

About the elect, and this is for the Christians listening, because they’re saying they are the elect: anybody who believes in white Jesus, how wrong you are. “For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect”. The Lord’s elect is only the Israelites.

If you’re not coming as Israel, you ain’t coming. You’re not sneaking up as no Roman Catholic, Baptist, Oneness Pentecostal, born again, charismatic, speaking in tongues, washed in the blood of the lamb madness. That ain’t happening; you’re going to die on that day.

sense.text: “He sent from above, he took me”: what does that mean? The angels came and grabbed us up. “He drew me out of many waters”: he delivered me out of all the troubles that were coming my way.

“He delivered me from my strong enemy”. Was there any enemy strong enough for David? Y’all forgot: he killed Goliath; David slew all his enemies. So this ain’t talking about David. David is prophesying about the elect in the last days.

“And from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.” Something heavy: why is David talking like this? Because David is to be here at that time. The enemy was too strong for me.
Notice verse 16 said “He sent from above, he took me”, and verse 19 says “He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.” What is this large place?
“The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.” Recompensed means judged. He’s going to reward us.

precepts.why:
The prophecy about those that hate you: “And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you”.

We’re here now. Those that hate us are ruling over us. We’re here in the United States of America, we’re here under Babylon the great, we are here under Esau, Edom. And wherever you go throughout the earth, I don’t care if it’s an African nation or a Caribbean nation, Esau is ruling everyone. That is the strong enemy, too strong for us.

What is this large place? “And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.” “Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord God.”

We’re going right back to the same wilderness our ancestors were in. That’s the large place he’s going to deliver us and bring us to: right back in Africa, right back there in that wilderness, in the northeast part.

He’s going to reward us. What is that talking about? “Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High”: judgment was given to the Israelites. “And the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom”: the time came that the saints ruled the world.

“And the nations were angry”. When the Lord returns, the Bible prophesies that the nations are going to be mad as hell. All these nations talk about, oh, we can’t wait for the Lord’s return: they’re lying. The Bible prophesied that when the Lord returns the nations will be angry. Why? Because their time of rulership will be finished.

“And thy wrath is come”: the wrath of God has come. “And the time of the dead, that they should be judged”: that’s us; we’re the dead. “And that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great”.

“And shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.” The Lord is going to destroy Esau, because that’s the nation that destroys the earth. But see this: God is going to judge us in an instant; he’s going to reward us in a moment.

“Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God”. So we’re going to be in the wilderness; we can’t enter the kingdom yet, because flesh and blood cannot enter the kingdom.

“Behold, I shew you a mystery”: this is a mystery; everybody ain’t going to understand this right here. “We shall not all sleep”: everybody’s not going to be dead. “But we shall all be changed, In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump”. That is the reward in an instant.

“For this corruptible must put on incorruption”: this corruptible body we all live in. “And this mortal must put on immortality”: this mortal body we all have. “Death is swallowed up in victory”: that’s going to be done; it’s going to be finished for us.

sense.text: Remember verse 20: “The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness”. Here is why: “For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.”

“I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.” That’s heavy right there. You want to just read on, but sometimes you’ve got to pause a moment and meditate on it. Everybody in here has an iniquity they are battling with, struggling with. Guess what you’d better do: keep yourself from it.

“Therefore hath the Lord recompensed me according to my righteousness”: recompense means judge; the Lord judged me, rewarded me according to my righteousness, “according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.”

Of course that cleanness, that righteousness, goes with us accepting and believing in Christ, coupled with keeping the commandments as a sign of faith.

Verse 27 clears it up. All the while David is allegedly talking about himself, he reveals it right there: “For thou wilt save the afflicted people”. It is the afflicted people he is speaking for. “But wilt bring down high looks”: that’s the proud, the men and women that break God’s laws.

“For thou wilt light my candle: the Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.” We all sin; this is the kingdom of darkness. He said he’s going to take us from here, bring us to a large place, and light our candle. That means he’s going to turn our spirits up. He’s going to change us. That’s what that verse means.

precepts.why:
This is for you Creflo lovers out there. “Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”

Two elements right there, and we need them both: we must be performing those things, keeping the commandments of God, and have faith in the Son of God. That is keeping the ways of the Lord and not wickedly departing from him.

I kept myself from mine iniquity: Paul says this, but to hear Creflo tell it, you ain’t got to do nothing. “Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth”: mortify means to deaden. These are the members we must put to death.

“Fornication”: sexual sins. You’d better get a hold of that thing and put that thing in check. “Uncleanness”: that’s a broad statement that covers a lot of things, whether it’s food or sexuality.

“Inordinate affection”: they showed the little boy jerking off to his daddy’s picture. Damn. And they got that on YouTube; they ain’t take that video down. All the immoral videos they leave up, but they’re pulling our videos down for teaching the commandments: it’s a hate group, teaching God’s commandments, that’s hatred. Inordinate affection is pedophiles too. It happened in North Carolina: this negro is going to drive three hours to meet a 12 year old, and she’s telling him, you know I’m 12, right? He says age is nothing but a number. He’s going to do 70 miles an hour for a 12 year old. What kind of delight is that? Then Chris Hansen opens the door: you got the bag you said you were going to bring, with the condoms and the beer? Put it on the table. That’s inordinate affection. Looking at a child: that’s a special kind of demon right there.

“Evil concupiscence”: strong sexual desire, lust. You stalker brothers, that’s concupiscence. She don’t want you, but I want her: that’s called stalking, all in the bushes about to jump out, fogging up the glass, trying to hide in the back seat of the sister’s car. At a Passover a brother told a sister, I’ve been looking at you and you be looking at me. She said, bro, I wasn’t looking at you, you’re not my type, but thank you, and walked away. She goes home from Passover, and the brother is in front of her house in his car. No, I’m calling the po-po, because you’re crazy. She don’t want you; she ain’t for you; she was not made for you. Men can be thirst buckets too: y’all call sisters thirst buckets, but some of you brothers are thirst buckets, drooling when you see a sister. You’d better hit the gym and work off your frustrations.

“And covetousness, which is idolatry”: you can go a whole lesson on that. These are the types of spirits we must deaden; we must mortify.

What does it mean, “thou wilt light my candle: the Lord my God will enlighten my darkness”? “And I will give him the morning star.” That’s what it means: I will give you the morning star; I will light your candle.

“But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.” Hold fast till I come means the same thing as wait upon the Lord.

Now he’s going to explain the candle being lit, the morning star being given to us. “And he that overcometh”: he that overcomes his own sin, her own sins, like I kept myself from mine iniquity. “And keepeth my works unto the end”: God’s commandments. “To him will I give power over the nations”. That’s the reward. That’s what Daniel 7:22 was talking about, and Revelation 11:18, about us getting judged.

“And he shall rule them with a rod of iron”: we’re going to rule the nations with a rod of iron. “As the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers”: we’re going to have to break the nations to get them in order. The nations ain’t going to run around doing whatever the hell they want; they have to be broken first. Did they not break us? They broke the hell out of us. We’re going to break them down into righteousness, and we’re going to return the true history, the correct history, to the whole planet earth again, and all nations are going to bow the knee to the one true King.

“Even as I received of my Father”: see what Christ said. The same power I got from my Father, I’m going to give to the Israelites. “And I will give him the morning star”: he’s going to light my candle. “He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.”

sense.text:
Why is he calling us a worm in Isaiah 41? Because in Psalms 18 he said, “He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.” The enemies of God are too strong for us right now; you’d better believe it.

That group with the guns running around, NFAC: the white man ain’t got to pull no gun on them. All Esau has to do is turn off the water, or don’t sell them the bullets; they’re going to run out soon. Cut off the water, don’t let no trucks enter with food, and starve them out. Shut down all electricity. That’s all they’ve got to do. Black people don’t understand; we don’t see what’s happening; we don’t see what is coming.

Once they say about your neighborhood, we want to starve them, shut off all the electricity, shut off the flow of water, stop the trucks bringing food in: what are you going to do? What can you do? Give them a week and they’re going to be starving, crying to the Lord, where’s that Popeye’s chicken. You’d better think about it; just ponder it. “For they were too strong for me”: David said it in the spirit about the afflicted people, about us.

precepts.why:
“Fear not, thou worm Jacob”. That’s what I’m telling all the plans. Ice Cube had a nice little plan set up; people got mad at him for sitting down to meet with Trump; he wanted to go on CNN with an economic plan for Black people. There’s no economic plan that’s going to save us. If there was, Black Wall Street would have been the first one, and what happened to Black Wall Street? And there were many Black Wall Streets they bombed. They’ve got movies out revisiting it: Watchmen on Amazon, and Lovecraft Country show you the evil that was done to Black Wall Street. You think it could never happen again: how foolish you are. It happened out of the blue. Trump said he’s against tearing down the monuments, because we need history, because history can repeat itself, and that went right over Black people’s heads.

“Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.” Why are we a worm? Because we are in captivity; we are powerless. This so-called white man, Esau, has nuclear armaments, nuclear capabilities; he controls the flow of water in the water system; he controls the imports and exports of food and of clothing. He controls it all. So we are a worm here; we have nothing. All the little economic plans are a band-aid on a bigger problem.

“Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth”. This is the change in the twinkling of an eye: he went from calling us a worm in verse 14 to calling us a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth, so sharp. “Thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small”: we’re going to thresh, meaning destroy, governments; that’s the mountains; we’re going to beat governments small. “And shalt make the hills as chaff”: the hills are the smaller governments.

“Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them”: we’re going to fan the nations. “And thou shalt rejoice in the Lord”: we’re going to praise the Lord, “and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.”

That is the change in the twinkling of an eye, when corruption shall put on incorruption and mortal shall put on immortality. From a worm whose enemies are too strong for him to a threshing instrument over the nations.

sense.text: “For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.” We read this and go, oh, that’s just David. It ain’t just David. Remember, he’s talking on behalf of the afflicted people.

precepts.why:
“They shall run like mighty men”: we’re going to run like mighty men. “They shall climb the wall like men of war”: we’re going to climb the wall like men of war, the same as leaping over a wall in Psalms 18:29. “And they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks”: and we ain’t breaking ranks either.

“Neither shall one thrust another”: ain’t going to be no black on black crime, ain’t going to be no fighting each other. “They shall walk every one in his path”: we’re going to walk straight on. “And when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded”: when somebody tries to stab us or harm us with their weapons, we shall not be wounded.

That’s God talk right there, that’s God level. This is what you read about with Samson. Not one spear pierced that man’s skin, not one arrow, not one knife. He was on God level, and we’re going right back to God level.

sense.text: “As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.” We’ve got to keep our trust in him.

“It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.” That’s the same God that strengthened Samson, and the Philistines were shocked at what they saw. Everybody imagines Samson as a big dude. No, he couldn’t have been no giant big dude. With Goliath, people said no, we ain’t fighting that guy, look how big he is. So Samson could not have been like that. Think for a moment: what would make tribes just keep coming? Everybody’s saying I could defeat him, and by the time they got there: jaw broke, neck broke, back broke, legs broke, dead, dead, dead, bodies heaped upon bodies, heaps upon heaps. What the hell is this?
“He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet”: a hind is a deer, like a gazelle. A gazelle can run 50 miles an hour, and leap tall buildings in a single bound. “And setteth me upon my high places.”

“He giveth power to the faint”: that’s what Christ said in Revelation 2, the same thing, giving power. “And to them that have no might he increaseth strength.” Who’s increasing strength? God. This is God talk right here. Connect the dots: that’s why the Bible says precept must be upon precept.
“Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall.”

“But they that wait upon the Lord”: he said wait ye upon me till I rise up to the prey. Everybody ain’t going to wait on the Lord. You got some of our young saying, we’re going to go out and do our own thing, we got an economic plan, we got a military plan. Okay. But as for us in our houses, we’re going to wait upon the Lord. That’s the “But” right there.

“Shall renew their strength”: renew meaning the strength we had at one time in days long gone. We’re going to get that strength back again. It’s not talking about the strength you had last week; that strength ain’t nothing. It’s talking about the strength our ancestors had in the past, renewed as in the days of old.

“They shall mount up with wings as eagles.” Y’all be reading things and just reading. Y’all talk about The Matrix, when Neo went up into the sky doing his Superman thing: they got all that from the Bible, mounting up with wings of eagles.

“They shall run, and not be weary.” You know how you run around the block and you’re all out of breath, tired as hell. Some of us run 10 feet and we’re huffing and puffing; get on a treadmill, passing out. This Bible is saying the promise is they shall run and not be tired, not be weary. “And they shall walk, and not faint”: and we ain’t going to faint in that day either.

precepts.why: “He giveth power to the faint.” Where are the faint? “Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets.” Our sons have fainted: we have lost consciousness to God’s truth. Those are the faint he gives power to.

They shall mount up with wings as eagles: let me show you some of Christ. “And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.” Taken up in the cloud. The people are talking to Christ, then they see gravity just loose off his body and the dude goes up. What the hell is this? A chariot received him.

“And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up”: you’ve got to imagine all the people saying, what the hell, did you see this? “Behold, two men stood by them in white apparel”: the two men that stood by were angels. “Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven?” Why were they gazing up? Because they never saw a man fly. “This same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.”

sense.text:
“He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet, and setteth me upon my high places. He teacheth my hands to war.” Many times reading, we go, this is David. No, it’s more than just David. It’s those that wait upon the Lord, it’s the afflicted people. The Lord’s going to teach us how to fight. We ain’t got to go to no dojo no more.

“So that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.” That’s that strength right there. How many of us can break steel right now with a punch? I don’t think anybody. Break your knuckles, maybe.
“Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.” God’s gentleness is going to make us great.
“Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.” We ain’t tripping, we ain’t falling down.

“I have pursued mine enemies”: mine enemies, the nations. And overtaken them: we shall run and not be tired, we shall walk and not faint. The nations think they’re going to get away from us. Nobody’s going to escape the Israelites. God level. “Neither did I turn again till they were consumed”: we don’t turn again till the nations are beat down dead. They’re going to be consumed.
“I have wounded them that they were not able to rise”: they ain’t ever going to rise up again. “They are fallen under my feet.”

precepts.why:
Micah said the same thing. God level, brothers. I know, sisters, we don’t look like much right now; we ain’t right, we’re crazy, half crazy. But there’s going to come a day when this is fulfilled, and we wait for it. And if we’re going to be on God level, the sisters are going to be on God level too. They ain’t going to have these weak little flabby, out-of-shape bodies; they’re going to be built like palaces. They’re going to run and not get weary too, walk and not faint too. This ain’t going to be a one-sided kingdom. A god needs a goddess; a king needs a queen.

“And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people”: we’re going to be in the midst of many people, “as a dew from the Lord, as the showers upon the grass”, meaning we’re going to be everywhere, “that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.”

“And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest.” When a lion enters the forest, guess what the other beasts do? Run, including the elephant, who’s bigger and stronger: let’s get the hell out of here. “As a young lion among the flocks of sheep”: what can sheep do against lions? Nothing but be eaten, become food. “Who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver”: none can deliver these other nations out of our hand once we get hold of them.

“Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries”: the adversaries are the enemies. “And all thine enemies shall be cut off”: all our enemies shall be cut off, the same as Psalms 18:38, they are fallen under my feet.

sense.text: “For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle”: that is God going to give us this strength, God level strength. “Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me”: everybody that rises up against us is going to be taken down.
“Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies”: necks, plural, of mine enemies. “That I might destroy them that hate me.”

precepts.why: That I might destroy them that hate me goes with this: “That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us.” We’re going to be saved from the hand of all that hate us.

sense.text:
“Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance”: for you Christians, Edom is the so-called white man. Edom is not black people. They took vengeance by enslaving us. “And hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them.”

This is what our people don’t like about Esau. Our people will do anything to save them; they will change their race.
“Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it.”

“And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel.” God says I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel. So we’re going to get a piece of the action, brothers. Not on this side of the world, but when he makes us God level, we’re going to get a piece. Lord, don’t kill them all; leave something for us. He’s going to leave a whole lot for us.

“And they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury.” Why his anger and his fury? Because we’re weak right now. You might stomp a male Edomite right now. But some of y’all deal with white women; you’re looking at the white woman, I don’t know if I could do it, Lord. What about the little baby? It’s a cute little baby. That’s why it says you’re going to do it according to my anger.

Right now we’ve got man eyes. In that day he’s going to give us God level eyes. You’ll be able to look at a person and see everything they’ve done in their past. You’re going to see a little baby and see the soul, what that child done did to us. Nobody’s going to escape. There was a movie called Frailty where the Edomite was killing people, nurses and doctors and lawyers, and his kids were saying, Dad, what are you doing? He said these are evil people. One kid understood; the other said my daddy’s crazy. At the end of the movie they showed you all the secret crimes those people were doing, the murders, and he was slaughtering them, but the dude looked crazy, because he saw what nobody else could see, what they had done secretly and in private. That’s what we’re reading about here: God’s going to put that spirit in us. We’re going to see what God sees. We ain’t going to see with these little flesh and blood eyes, because we see carnally; we’re going to see things spiritually in that day. We’re going to know all their names in the past: in this day and age you were this, and this is what you done did, and I see it now. It’s time for judgment. You dead.

I ain’t talking crazy, sisters; these are future events. We’re just reading the book. These things you ain’t going to read in the Christian church; all you get is John 3:16 all day.

“And they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord God.” But the Bible says vengeance is the Lord’s. Yes, and on this day he’s going to give us a taste. The Lord says, okay, I had enough; you go on, follow up behind me. That’s what’s going to happen.

precepts.why:
There are brothers and sisters so angry at IUIC, at what we teach and how we teach, that one of them did a video and said we’re going to destroy the doctrine that Esau is the white man. This is what they did. “Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom. Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan”: so they said, see, Esau married Hamite women. “The daughter of Elon the Hittite”, “the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite”, and “Ishmael’s daughter”: Esau married Ishmael’s daughters. So they said, if Esau’s descendants married Canaanite women and Arab women, that means their children are all black.

So all Esau’s descendants are black, because God don’t have the power to keep Esau’s look pure through generations? He’s powerless to do that? Let’s play with that thought hypothetically: all Esau’s descendants are black. Then go to Obadiah and read about Esau.
“The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”: these are the children of Esau.

“Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars.” What black race is doing space travel? Somebody help me; I want to know the black race that has set their nest among the stars.

Read the verse above it: “The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” In order to say who can bring me down, meaning who can conquer me, can’t nobody beat me, you’ve got to have power in the earth. Looking through the earth now, what black nation has the power to say can’t nobody beat me? Where is this black race at?

So where is the black race that has power that no one can defeat them, that has power to set their nest among the stars? If any of y’all follow these people, y’all simple as hell. Then another group points to the Arabs. What Arab nation can say that? They just got bombed and held back. Ain’t no Arabs going up to the moon. These people are crazy. Edom, Esau, is the so-called white man.

sense.text:
“Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind.” When I read this stuff I wake up, I think about this stuff and go yes, give me that day. I ain’t sitting around moping; I want this to come to pass yesterday. This should give you hope. Your sons and your daughters should be trusting in this, not sitting around waiting for the next soap opera to come on, waiting for the next basketball game: he put the ball in the hoop. That’s insane. We’re going to get it.

“I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.” We’re going to cast the nations out like dirt in the streets, the same way they did to us. Did they not treat our ancestors like dirt in the streets? Three-fifths of a man, you were nothing. They spit on us, pissed on us, and they’re still doing it. The white man is the devil the Bible speaks of.

“I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets”: we gonna cast the nations out like dirt in the streets, the same way they did to us. They spit on us, pissed on us, and they still doing it.

Let me show you how evil Esau is. A well-known pastor pissed on a sleeping black woman on a plane, and they didn’t give the pastor’s name, his race, his church, his picture. If it was one of us, his face, his name and his church would be everywhere, but not for the white man. That’s how you know it’s a devil: they’ll manufacture stuff against us, stuff that ain’t even true, and hide their own.

They said he had a reaction to a sleep aid. That’s the lie. She was sitting there, he was facing her; if that was true he would have urinated on himself and it would have went down between his feet, not to the left or to the right. He had to turn it on her and shake it off on her. The white man is the devil the Bible speaks of. The mere fact that they wrote the article like that shows they’re in cahoots with disrespecting black people. They have no respect for us at all, and he won’t be charged; that’s why they gave no name, no pictures, no nothing.

That’s the reason why this vengeance is so wonderful. I can’t wait for it.

“Thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me. As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.” Israel is made the head of the heathen. The strangers, the other nations, are going to submit themselves unto us and serve us.

precepts.why: “The strangers shall submit themselves unto me”: Isaiah shows what that submission looks like. “And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee.” The sons of the other nations will build up Israel’s walls, and their kings will minister unto us.

sense.text:
“Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles”: the forces of the Gentiles means the wealth of the Gentiles. “And that their kings may be brought”: their kings are going to be brought down in servitude as well.

What Isaiah explains in detail, Revelation gives very abbreviated. The New Testament is an abbreviation of Old Testament prophecies; you need the Old Testament, which explains things in greater detail.

“For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.” They’ll never read this to you in church. Never.

We’re going to be on god level like never before. Remember Adam was the son of God; in Genesis 6 we were called the sons of God; God said about us in Exodus 4:22, ‘Israel is my son, even my firstborn’; Psalms 82:6 says ye are gods, but you shall die like men. Now we’re going to be judged by the Lord, and this judgment is a righteous judgment where he gives us power. That’s Revelation 2: Christ said I will give you the morning star. He’s going to light our candle and turn up that spiritual side of us.

“The sons also of them that afflicted thee”: that’s the white man, Esau, the Chinese, the Japanese, the Arabs, that’s Ishmael, and the Hamites. All nations afflicted us. They “shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.” They gonna come bending unto us. They’re gonna bow the knee.

precepts.why:
In case there’s a Christian listening, Revelation says the same thing: the gates are open continually. “And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there. And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.”

That’s god level. When we beat these nations so bad, we’re going to force them to bring their wealth to us, because guess what: their wealth is our wealth. Revelation gives it short; Isaiah 60:11 gives it in detail, the forces of the Gentiles and their kings brought.

There’s a scripture in the last chapters of Isaiah where they shall know our sons and daughters. “And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles”: whatever city or kingdom God gives us, all the nations are going to know us, our wives and our children by name. “And their offspring among the people”: they’ll say that’s such and such’s children. They’re gonna know who our sons and daughters are, and when our kids walk down the street they’re going to bow the knee and move the hell out the way. That’s god level, baby.

“All that see them shall acknowledge them”: all that see us shall acknowledge us, “that they are the seed which the Lord hath blessed.” This is the seed that God has blessed.

They ain’t gonna read this to you in church; don’t hold your breath. “Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee”: all the nations that afflict us are going to be undone, because God is going to give us power. That’s the sons of them that afflicted thee coming bending.

“And I will save her that halteth”: that’s us, we’re the ones that halt. He’s going to save us, “and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.” The Lord says I’m going to give them praise and fame in every land. That’s why all nations are going to know, not just us, but our offspring, our sons and daughters, our wives. This is glory.

There are going to be books written on us. “And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies”: these popes and reverends and ministers. “They shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel.” They ain’t going to be written, but we are going to be written in the writings of Israel.

Y’all thought the Acts of the Apostles was done. No, we’re still in the book of Acts, and it’s going to be recorded in heaven. There are going to be books on the men and women that make it out of here: what they went through, how they survived, how they made it, how they got over, like that old church song. There are going to be some new chronicles on the earth. Gods rise.

“Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?” Don’t ever think the Old Testament writings are done away with, obsolete. Everything Christ said was based on the Old Testament writings; have you lost your minds? Christ was quoting Psalms 82:6. When he said “Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods”, he was talking about these Israelite men and women: they are gods.

“If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken”: that’s heavy. When it says the scripture cannot be broken, you can’t change what has been prophesied. You can vote, you can dance, you can march; it ain’t changing nothing. The Bible says we’re gods.

I know they look down on us today. We don’t look like nothing; we out of shape, we sick, half of us got all kind of ailments. The Bible says don’t worry about that: he said I’m going to help you, Jacob, you worm. We’re going to be changed. God level; that’s what I’m waiting on.

“In that day shall the Lord defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David.” That’s what we’ve been reading in Psalms 18: David was prophesying about us, our strength being renewed as in the days of old. He that is feeble is going to be like David.

“And the house of David shall be as God”: the house of David, that’s the 144, shall be as gods. The church ain’t going to tell us this; they want to keep us as Negroes and Latinos and Hispanics and Indians. No, we’re waiting on god level, and in order to get that god level we got to keep the commandments of God and have the faith of Jesus.

“And as we have borne the image of the earthy”: the image of the earthy is these bodies we got now. “We shall also bear the image of the heavenly”: we’re going to bear the image of the heavenly. That’s god level; that’s what the apostle Paul was talking about. Don’t worry about these earthly bodies; we’re going to have god-level bodies.

“Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption. Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed, In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed. For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.”

“And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain”: Paul is speaking another mystery, and he’s talking about us. You sow seed in the ground and it has one type of body, but in time that body from the seed changes to another body; it may become wheat or some other type of grain. “But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.”

“All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.” There were these guys that said we come from monkeys and baboons, the Darwin theory, all that garbage; the Bible says the flesh of men is its own flesh.

“There are also celestial bodies”: celestial bodies are god-level bodies. “And bodies terrestrial”: terrestrial is what we got now, earthly bodies, weak bodies. “But the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another. There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.”

“So also is the resurrection of the dead.” What we’ve been talking about all day is the resurrection time, and we’re the dead. “It is sown in corruption”: corruptible bodies; “it is raised in incorruption.” “It is sown in dishonour”: we are born here in dishonor; “it is raised in glory.” That’s god level. “It is sown in weakness”: these bodies we got are weak as hell; “it is raised in power.” “It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body”: that’s that celestial body, that god body.

“The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam”, that’s Christ, “was made a quickening spirit.”

sense.text:
“The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek”: that’s our job, brothers. He anointed us to preach good tidings unto the meek, the humble, those men and women that are meek to the laws of God. To be meek to the laws of God means we’re going to do what is written.

“He hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted”: are we not the brokenhearted? We are the brokenhearted people. “To proclaim liberty to the captives”: we are to proclaim liberty to the captives of our people, because our people are captive under Babylon the Great. “And the opening of the prison”: we are prophesying about a day when this prison called the United States of America is opened and our people are delivered, every last man, woman, boy and girl that repents in the name of the Lord.

“To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of vengeance of our God”: we are to proclaim that the day of vengeance of our God is coming. I don’t know what the hell these preachers are talking about, but the day of vengeance is what we’re supposed to be prophesying about.

“To comfort all that mourn”: that type of preaching comforts all our people that mourn. The only way we can help the families, the kinsfolk, of the George Floyds and the Trayvon Martins is to preach the day of vengeance. That is a comfort to all that mourn.

“To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion”: it ain’t talking about everybody; Zion is another name for Israel. “To give unto them beauty for ashes”: some of us think we look good, but God says I’m going to give you beauty for ashes, because y’all busted right now, every man, woman and boy; we all busted. Malcolm made a statement: who taught you to hate yourself? We’ve been taught to hate the way we look, everything about ourselves. They compared us to monkeys; they put a monkey up next to your face and made a mockery. Don’t worry about that. You’re going to be beautified in that day, every man and woman. Nobody is ever going to look down on us; they’re going to look up at us. These terrible bodies we got, out of shape, all kind of stuff wrong with us: don’t worry, the Lord says I’m going to give you beauty.

“The oil of joy for mourning”: we’re going to get the oil of joy for mourning. “The garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness”: the spirit of heaviness is depression; we’re going to get the garment of praise for the spirit of depression.

“That they might be called trees of righteousness”: we’re going to be trees of righteousness, “the planting of the Lord, that he might be glorified.” Him planting us glorifies him, because we are his people. Isaiah complained: ‘we are your people, Lord, but we are at the bottom; these heathen are reigning over us.’

“And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks”: the other nations are going to stand and feed our flocks. “And the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers”: the white man is the son of the alien. They’re the real aliens, and they’re going to be our plowmen and our vinedressers.

“But ye shall be named the Priests of the Lord”: in that day we’re going to be real priests of the Lord. “Men shall call you the Ministers of our God”: god level; they’re going to call us the ministers of our God.

“Ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.” We’re going to boast ourselves when we’re taking their wealth, because their wealth is our wealth. There ain’t going to be no ‘why you bragging’. We’re going to brag; we’re going to boast.

This is going to be perfect revenge. The Most High wants perfect revenge; he don’t want to leave it up to us. The Most High said he was going to undo the afflictions, undo the things that were done to us. We’ve suffered all kinds of psychological hang-ups: watching our people get murdered, watching our women get mistreated, peed on and stuff like that. The Most High’s got the sweet, perfect vengeance.

“And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom”: the Most High says he’s going to lay his vengeance upon Edom, and upon all the nations; like in Obadiah, all of the nations are going to drink the cup. “By the hand of my people Israel.”

“And they shall do in Edom according to mine anger”: the reason the Most High wants us to do it according to his anger is because he wants the revenge to be perfect. We might mess up, we might not get it right; the Most High said no, I’m going to make sure you get it perfect. They, we, shall do in Edom and in all the nations according to God’s anger. That’s perfect revenge, and that’s the therapy we need after all of this craziness we went through here. We watched a man get choked to death on the ground with an officer’s knee on his neck, crying out for his deceased mother; all of us felt that thing, and the Most High saw it too.

“And according to my fury”: according to God’s fury, not our fury. Our fury ain’t good enough; the Most High says I need it to be perfect fury. “And they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord God”: it’s going to be considered God’s vengeance, and we’re going to be happy about that thing.

precepts.why:
I’ma prove we’re going to be happy about it. “Let the saints be joyful in glory”: the saints are the Israelites, and glory is the kingdom of heaven. Only the Israelites are going to rejoice in the Most High’s glory. “Let them sing aloud upon their beds”: we’re going to wake up, give orders and go back to sleep. That’s the beauty.

“Let the high praises of God be in their mouth”: the high praises of the Bible in our mouths, “and a twoedged sword in their hand”: a killing instrument in our hands. This is the perfect vengeance right here.

Think about undoing the afflictions. They used to make us jump off the sidewalk and walk in the gutter when they walked by. Grown men had to step off the sidewalk and walk in the gutter, with their wives with them seeing them do it. Over generations that produces inferiority complexes in front of your wives and your children, a whole bevy of traumas, disrespect and messed-up self-esteem. They’re gonna pay for all of that. Perfect vengeance.

“To execute vengeance upon the heathen”: that’s what we’re going to do with this sword. That’s God’s vengeance, and we execute it upon the nations. “And punishments upon the people”: they’re all going into captivity and slavery. That’s therapy. You ain’t getting no therapy laying on somebody’s couch; the therapy is going to come when this stuff gets executed, and the therapy begins with this Bible.

“To bind their kings with chains”: that’s instant therapy right there, just putting chains on your enemies. They can have fitting rooms for different size chains, one for the collars, the head, everything else, garments of pure chains. Remember the movie Birth of a Nation, when they whooped him and said ‘you’re learning the lesson, boy’, and he smiled and started to laugh; this is what was on his mind. “And their nobles with fetters of iron”: their kings and their princes, that Prince Charles, their Queen Elizabeth II, all of them with chains on them. That’s wonderful.

“To execute upon them the judgment written”: what are we doing? We’re doing what God has written in the Bible, executing upon all of the nations the judgment written by God. “This honour have all his saints”: this is the beautiful part. The Most High is honoring Israel by allowing us to put our enemies in chains. Thank God that’s written in God’s judgment, the oracles of God; that has to be the perfect judgment the Most High is going to bring.

I’m saving the best one for last. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” When the Babylonians came in and destroyed Israel, they were there helping do the destruction, so they all gonna get it. That’s what they did to us.

“O daughter of Babylon”: this is Edom particularly, because he’s the ringleader of all of the evil that happened to us. “Who art to be destroyed”: that’s their lot. They are the vessels of God’s wrath; they were made, they were fitted, to be destroyed. They were created for God’s destruction, made to be the channel of God’s destruction. Ponder on that: the whole reason for them being on this earth is to be the channel of God’s anger.

“Happy shall he be”: why are we going to be happy? Because God is going to put that in our spirit. It ain’t going to be according to what we want; the Most High says you’re going to be happy when you do this, because I’m making it so. Perfect vengeance. “Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.”

“Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.” We’re going to be happy to bash their babies up against stones, bust their heads wide open, grab more babies and smash them up. It’s perfect vengeance. That’s why verse 8 says happy shall he be that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us: because they did that to us, and they got pictures of it, of them doing it to us, postcards and all that. So it’s going to go down. The Most High said, y’all move out the way, I want you to do it according to what I want, perfectly done. That’s the gospel.

The word gospel just means good news, and this is Isaiah 61: we’re supposed to comfort all that mourn. “The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance”: the righteous shall rejoice when we see the vengeance.

“He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.” We get to thinking about washing our feet in the blood of the wicked and we like, damn, I don’t want to get all this blood on me; some of you might be thinking that way. The Most High said in that day you’re going to be happy to do that. We’re going to be dancing in people’s blood. That’s beautiful; that’s righteous anger.

That’s therapy; that’s what we need. It’s going to clear up all of this inferiority, the post-traumatic stuff. We ain’t going to need the white man’s nothing; that’s how you get out of this craziness. And they ain’t going to be able to look up, period: they’ll have to have their heads bowed down all the time.
